belongs_to: Raghav practices yoga in the morning. Two pictures with a wall clock each; Q1 'At what time did Raghav start practising Yoga?', Q2 'At what time did he finish?', Q3 'How much time did he spend practising Yoga?'
description: Two side-by-side panels (grey-purple wall above a dark-grey floor, a yellow mat on the floor), each with a round wall clock in the top-right corner. Clock face: dark navy rim, white face, numerals 1 to 12, minute dots (larger dot every 5 minutes), thin inner circle, red hub dot; only TWO hands, no seconds hand: minute hand = long orange arrow, hour hand = shorter thick blue arrow. LEFT panel (before yoga): Raghav (boy, blue striped T-shirt, brown trousers) standing on the mat with palms joined in front of the chest; clock: minute hand on 7 (35 minutes), hour hand between 5 and 6 (about halfway), so 05:35. RIGHT panel (after yoga): Raghav sitting cross-legged on the mat in a meditation pose, eyes closed; clock: minute hand on 11 (55 minutes), hour hand just before 6, so 05:55. No times are written anywhere in the pictures; the three answers are blanks. Reading: start 05:35 a.m., finish 05:55 a.m., 20 minutes.
unclear: Exact hour-hand angles are approximate in the picture (left clock hour hand at about 5.5, right clock hour hand at about 5.6); the readings 05:35 and 05:55 come from the minute hands (on 7 and on 11) and agree with the LP.
